source: ECMWF ERA5 (Copernicus C3S) via Climate Reanalyzer, University of Maine
enso_methodology: Calendar-year mean of NOAA CPC's Oceanic Nino Index (ONI) across available 3-month seasons. El Nino >= +0.5C, La Nina <= -0.5C, else Neutral. Years before 1950 predate the ONI record and are shown unclassified.
